name: serpapi
description: Search web, news, shopping, maps, and more with SerpApi.

interface.longDescription: Search Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, Google Maps, and more through SerpApi. Research news, compare product prices, find local businesses, and discover academic papers with links to the sources. Requires a SerpApi account and API key to get started.
defaultPrompt: Find this week's major AI search news and cite the original sources.
Compare current AirPods Pro listings on Amazon, Walmart, and eBay.
Find well-reviewed coffee shops near Times Square.
